reason: BatteryPass key for the passport identifier. Its former target eubat:batteryPassportIdentifier was deleted as a duplicate of oec:passportIdentifier (EN 18223 digitalProductPassportId, EU core-vocabulary exactMatch); the key keeps its meaning and now lands on the surviving term.
Same as productIdentifier: eubat:batteryPassportIdentifier deleted as a duplicate of oec:passportIdentifier.
eubat:lastDataUpdate deleted as a duplicate of oec:lastUpdated (EN 18223 lastUpdated, EU core-vocabulary exactMatch); same datatype, same meaning.

eubat:hasInitialInternalResistance deleted: EC guidance 3.2 data point 38 asks for a cell and a pack value, and one undifferentiated value fills neither. The key keeps its upstream SAMM IRI so incoming values are preserved losslessly, as the bridge already does for other flat longlist values.
eubat:expectedNumberOfCycles deleted as a duplicate of eubat:expectedCycleLife (EU battery-vocabulary expectedLifetimeCycles exactMatch).
eubat:numberOfFullCycles deleted as a duplicate of eubat:hasCycleCount (EU battery-vocabulary numberOfChargingCycles).
